why: Git lesson s8. The heading is 'Git Going' in index.html and the edit is committed on update-name. A bare `git push` failed first ('fatal: The current branch update-name has no upstream branch'), and git printed the fix; the learner ran it, `git push --set-upstream origin update-name`, which pushed: ' * [new branch] update-name -> update-name'. That is the step's push (git push origin update-name plus tracking).

Terminal: tripi@mac gitgoing % git commit -m "update app name"
